Description (SPA): Identificador estable del escaño oficial del Senado.
Description (ENG): Stable identifier for the official Senate seat assignment.
Notes: Hash of a natural seat key rather than the candidate spelling.

Description (SPA): Concurso electoral que produjo la integración oficial.
Description (ENG): Election contest that produced the official composition.
Notes: The identifier anchors the 2024 integration even though this dimension also contains FM and RP seats.

Description (SPA): Legislatura federal a la que corresponde el escaño.
Description (ENG): Federal legislature associated with the seat.
Notes: Used to constrain the Senado identity roster.

Description (SPA): Principio por el que se asignó el escaño.
Notes: MR is mayoría relativa; FM is primera minoría; RP is representación proporcional.

Description (SPA): Partido político al que INE atribuye el escaño.
Description (ENG): Political party to which INE assigns the seat.
Notes: Seat ownership rather than a coalition vote-result option.

Description (SPA): Clave de entidad para escaños MR y FM.
Description (ENG): State identifier for MR and FM seats.

Description (SPA): Nombre de entidad para escaños MR y FM.
Description (ENG): State name for MR and FM seats.
Notes: Preserved from the official integration source.

Description (SPA): Posición de la fórmula o candidatura en la integración oficial.
Description (ENG): Position of the slate or candidacy in the official integration.
Notes: Positions 1-2 produce MR seats and position 3 produces the first-minority seat in state slates; RP uses party-list position.

Description (SPA): Nombre de la persona candidata titular publicado por INE.
Description (ENG): Titular candidate name published by INE.
Notes: The titular is attempted first during identity resolution.

Description (SPA): Nombre de la persona suplente publicado por INE.
Description (ENG): Substitute candidate name published by INE.
Notes: Can be selected when the substitute rather than titular appears in the roll-call roster.

Description (SPA): Campo oficial usado para enlazar la identidad observada.
Description (ENG): Official name role used to link the observed identity.

Description (SPA): Nombre oficial seleccionado con capitalización homogénea.
Description (ENG): Selected official name with normalized display casing.

Description (SPA): Tokens normalizados del nombre para comparación entre fuentes.
Description (ENG): Normalized name tokens for cross-source comparison.
Notes: Removes accents and ordering differences used by the matcher.

Description (SPA): Identificador observado en las votaciones del Senado cuando la correspondencia es confiable.
Description (ENG): Observed Senate roll-call identifier when the identity match is reliable.
Notes: Use this key rather than names to join vote history.

Description (SPA): Nombre observado en senado.gob.mx para la correspondencia seleccionada.
Description (ENG): Name observed on senado.gob.mx for the selected match.
Notes: Retained so the cross-source match can be inspected.

Description (SPA): Método y estado de la correspondencia de identidad.
Description (ENG): Method and status of the identity match.
Notes: Audited overrides cover manually verified aliases without weakening the general matcher.

Description (SPA): Similitud de tokens para la correspondencia aplicada.
Description (ENG): Token similarity for the applied match.
Notes: Used to audit approximate matches; audited overrides can have lower lexical similarity.

Description (SPA): Ruta local del archivo oficial que originó el registro.
Description (ENG): Local path of the official source file.

Description (SPA): Marca de tiempo generada al materializar la dimensión.
Description (ENG): Timestamp generated when the dimension is materialized.
